$comment: Keyword table of tools/audit/coverage_check.ps1 (S0025 section 6). Reviewed in every diff: an entry may be added, never dropped. 'claudeMd' is a case-insensitive regex that must match CLAUDE.md section 1 (empty for a surface beyond CLAUDE.md); 'scenes' is a list of alternatives, each alternative a list of lower-case tokens that must ALL occur in the text of one scene row (the Scene, user's action and risk columns of the scene catalog); a capability is covered when at least one scene matches at least one alternative. 'reviewedSection1Sha256' pins the whitespace-collapsed text of CLAUDE.md section 1 this table was reviewed against: when section 1 changes, the check fails until the table is re-reviewed and the pin regenerated with: pwsh -NoProfile -File tools/audit/coverage_check.ps1 -PrintSection1Hash

capabilities.claudeMd: live broadcast from the phone \(microphone, camera\)
